payload.claim: check_adr_supersession's mirror check on the superseded_by side (`elif m.id not in _adr(by_id[other]).supersedes`) is exercised by the test's ADR 3 and ADR 8 fixtures but no assertion in test_adr_supersession_is_held_equal_on_both_sides ever checks its output — every `assert any(...)` in that test targets either the supersedes-side mirror violation (`'does not list 6 in superseded_by'`) or unrelated status checks. Deleting this elif clause (leaving only the `if other not in by_id` existence check in that loop) leaves every existing assertion true, so the test suite stays green, while the acceptance criterion's 'one side without its mirror on the other' case goes unverified from the superseded_by direction — an ADR that lists a superseded_by target which does not reciprocate in `supersedes` would no longer be flagged, and nothing in this diff's tests would notice.
